title.intro: Monsters swarm in hordes. Survive each stage until the timer runs out, collect EXP crystals to level up and pick new skills. Every skill fires on its own, so all you do is move and dodge.
title.keys:
WASD/ARROWS move
SPACE Ultimate when the gauge is full
P pause   M mute
Mobile: touch and drag to move
level.title: LEVEL UP!  LV {lv}
level.slots: Attack slots {n}/{max} (when full you only get upgrades)
chest.title: TREASURE CHEST
clear.title: STAGE {n} CLEAR
clear.note: Next stage: tougher, harder-hitting and more monsters. You recover 40% HP before it starts.
over.title: GAME OVER
msg.title: ROOM
shop.title: SHOP
shop.note: Upgrades bought here last forever. Gold comes from monsters and boss chests, and goes to your wallet when you clear a stage or lose.
pause.title: PAUSED
pause.text: Press P or the button below to continue
pause.leave: End this run and go to title
pause.leaveNote: Gold from this run goes to your wallet and your score is recorded.
